Correction to my first entry: for g11v1 I put "replicated":"no" in the JSON, but the rationale correctly reasons it should be "yes" (TCGA RNA concordant, no opposing cohort). The intended value for g11v1 is replicated = yes.

answers.rationale: CPTAC protein log2fc -0.94, padj 1e-10 → down (no). CPTAC RNA is down (padj 1e-10), the reference. TCGA RNA is also down (padj 1e-8), same direction. No confirmatory protein record for this entity. So one independent cohort agrees and none opposes → replicated yes.
CPTAC protein log2fc -2.51, padj 1e-10 → no. CPTAC RNA down (padj 1e-10) is the reference; TCGA RNA is down (padj 1e-8), concordant, none opposite → yes.
CPTAC protein log2fc 1.83, padj 2.2e-27 → up. CPTAC RNA up (padj 3e-12) is the reference; TCGA RNA up (padj 2.5e-11), concordant, no opposite cohort → replicated.

No CPTAC protein record for the target, so protein_up is insufficient. CPTAC RNA down (padj 2.5e-29) is the reference; TCGA RNA down and confirmatory protein down, both padj<0.05, none opposite → yes.
